newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees '97 rolled steel output up 7-8 percent.
newsitem.headline: China sees '97 rolled steel output up 7-8 percent.

text.p: China's rolled steel output is expected to reach 92.0 million tonnes in 1997, up 7-8 percent compared with last year, the China Daily said on Tuesday.
Earlier estimates have put rolled steel output for the year at 88.0 million tonnes, up 2.5 million tonnes compared with 1996.

Domestic demand for rolled steel this year would exceed 100.0 million tonnes, the China Daily said quoting figures from the Ministry of Internal Trade. China consumed 98-100 million tonnes of rolled steel in 1996.
China was seen consuming 120.0 million tonnes of rolled steel, including more than 50.0 million tonnes of steel plates and pipes, in the year 2000, state media has said.
